image_description: A street scene featuring a horizontal traffic light assembly suspended from a curved metal mast arm. The primary subject is a vertical traffic signal head with three circular lenses (red, amber, green) and visors. A second, smaller traffic signal is visible in the background on the left. The setting includes a paved road, a grassy median, trees, and commercial buildings in the distance under an overcast sky.
